title: DCPSC Order No. 23135 (2026-07-29) — The Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia, in Formal Case No. 1156 and Electric Tariff 2021-02, by Order No. 23135, dated July 29, 2026, granted
description: The Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia, in Formal Case No. 1156 and Electric Tariff 2021-02, by Order No. 23135, dated July 29, 2026, granted the Potomac Electric Power Company’s Motion for an enlargement of time to file the House of Worship Working Group (“HOW WG”) report of its program recommendations. The HOW WG report is now due on September 30, 2026.
text:
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA 
1325 G STREET, N.W., SUITE 800 
WASHINGTON, D.C. 20005 

ORDER ON DELEGATED AUTHORITY 
July 29, 2026 
FORMAL CASE NO. 1156, IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF THE 
POTOMAC ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY FOR AUTHORITY TO IMPLEMENT A 
MULTIYEAR RATE PLAN FOR ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION SERVICE IN THE 
DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA 

and 

ELECTRIC TARIFF 2021-02, IN THE MATTER OF THE POTOMAC ELECTRIC 
POWER COMPANY’S HOUSE OF WORSHIP AND NON-PROFIT CUSTOMER 
CREDIT TARIFF, P.S.C.-D.C. No. 1, Order No. 23135 

I. 
INTRODUCTION 

1. 
By this Order,1 the Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia 
(“Commission”) grants the Potomac Electric Power Company’s (“Pepco” or “Company”) Motion 
for an enlargement of time to file the House of Worship Working Group (“HOW WG”) report of its 
program recommendations (“Pepco Motion”).2 The HOW WG report is now due on September 
30, 2026. 

II. 
BACKGROUND 

2. 
In Formal Case No. 1156, Order No. 22756, the Commission directed HOW WG 
to meet and discuss issues related to the future of the Program, such as an impending Program cost 
recovery method, Program measurement metrics, and any other recommended Program 
improvements.3 The working group was directed to submit a report of its Program 

1

the Matter of the Investigation into the Public Service Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure, Order 
No. 22731, ¶ 2(g), issued October 30, 2025 (“The Commission’s General Counsel, or his or her designee, is delegated 
authority to act and issue orders on the following matters: . . . g. Unopposed Motions for Extension of Time”). Any 
party may file a petition for reconsideration of the General Counsel’s decision with the Commission. 

2 
Formal Case No. 1156, In the Matter of the Application of the Potomac Electric Power Company for 
Authority to Implement a Multiyear Rate Plan for Electric Distribution Service in the District of and Electric Tariff 
2021-02, In the Matter of the Potomac Electric Power Company’s House of Worship and Non-Profit Customer Credit 
Tariff, P.S.C.-D.C. No. 1 Columbia (“Formal Case No. 1156 and ET2021-02”), Unopposed Motion of Potomac 
Electric Power Company for an Enlargement of Time to File a Report of 2ts Program Recommendations, filed July 
14, 2026 (“Pepco Motion”). 

3 
Formal Case No. 1156 and ET2021-02, Order No. 22756, rel. December 17, 2025 (“Order No. 22756”).

recommendations by August 1, 2026.4 The HOW WG met on July 17, 2026. Among other issues, 
the working group discussed the need for an extension of time to file its report. Pepco filed its 
Motion on July 24, 2026, requesting an extension until September 30, 2026, to file the report 
required by Order No. 22756.5 

III. 
DISCUSSION 

3. 
Generally, the Commission will grant a request of this nature if good cause is 
shown.6 Pepco indicates that additional time is needed so that the working group members may 
develop and submit its report. The Motion is unopposed, so there is no prejudice to any party. 
Further, a 60-day extension does not constitute inordinate delay. Accordingly, the Commission 
grants Pepco’s Motion and extends the time for filing the working group report until September 
30, 2026. 

THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED THAT: 

4. 
The Potomac Electric Company’s Motion for an Enlargement of Time to File the 
House of Worship Working Group Report is GRANTED; and 

5. 
The House of Worship Working Group Report required by paragraph 13 of Order 
No. 22756 shall be filed by September 30, 2026. 

A TRUE COPY: 

BY DIRECTION OF THE COMMISSION: 

CHIEF CLERK: 

BRINDA WESTBROOK-SEDGWICK 

COMMISSION SECRETARY
